name: explicit-design-invocation
description: Explicit design invocation remains authoritative with brainstorm available. Stage test-files as an isolated workspace, never in place under the hosting skill.
prompt: Use $kk:design to write a design document, implementation plan, and task list for the archive command described in README.md.
trap: The explicit invocation is overridden by brainstorm or its conversation-only boundary.

assertions.text: The trace loads the explicitly requested $kk:design and never $kk:brainstorm.
Existing design confirmations precede drafting; the explicit invocation does not waive the gates.
All three planning artifacts are written in docs/feat/wip/archive-command/ and the final response recommends review without implementing the command.
